<script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@graph":[{"@type":"FAQPage","@id":"https://www.praxerasupplements.com/quality-standards#faq","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"Are your certifications independently audited or self-declared?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Independently audited. SQF certification is awarded by SQF International and renewed through annual third-party audits. NSF GMP 455-2 certification requires unannounced facility inspections and full documentation review by NSF auditors. None of our certifications are pay-to-list or self-declared."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can I get certificates of analysis (COA) for my products?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. Every production batch generates a certificate of analysis covering identity, purity, and potency testing. COAs are available on request for any product you private label with us, and can be provided to your customers on request as well."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"What is the difference between FDA-registered and FDA-approved?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"FDA does not 'approve' dietary supplements before they go to market. FDA-registered means the facility is registered with the FDA as a food facility and subject to FDA inspection. Our facility is FDA-registered and has been inspected. Combined with our GMP certifications, this gives a clear picture of regulatory compliance."}},{"@type":"Question","name":"Can you support custom testing requirements for my brand?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Yes. Beyond our standard testing protocols, we can run additional testing for specific ingredients, contaminants, or claims your brand wants to verify (heavy metals, allergens, microbials, specific actives). Custom testing requirements are scoped during the formulation phase."}}]}]}</script>
<!-- QBS-SCHEMA:END -->
